title: Corinthia Rome vs Casa Monti: Grand Opening or Boutique? (2026) | Suites With Keith
description: Corinthia Rome vs Casa Monti, compared by a travel advisor who visited both in October 2026: a grand new hotel or a hip boutique, quiet or neighborhood life, rooms, spas, and who each one suits.

hero.alt: A Corinthia Rome bedroom with a bronze canopy bed, pink upholstered headboard and a terrace draped in bougainvillea
A Casa Monti room with orange curtains, a green zigzag armchair, a tulip floor lamp and a bird-print fabric alcove

sub: Both have a spa, and that is where the likeness ends. One is a grand hotel with large rooms on a quiet square; the other is a cute boutique hotel among the trattorias of Monti. Here is how I would choose.

choose.h3: If you want space and calm
choose.lead: Wow. A showstopper renovation, large rooms and a beautiful spa, across from parliament: incredibly safe and quiet while still in the middle of everything.
choose.alt: A Corinthia Rome suite living room with a white sofa, cognac leather accents and marble floors

choose.h3: If you want hip, young and fun
choose.lead: So cute. A boutique hotel from the team behind Le Fantaisie in Paris, with a beautiful rooftop, real trattorias all around and a spa couples can have to themselves.
choose.alt: A Casa Monti terrace with patterned chairs and climbing jasmine over the tiled rooftops of Monti

band.h2: Do you want a grand hotel to retreat to, or a neighborhood to live in?
paras: The Corinthia is a retreat in the middle of the city. It is across the street from parliament, so it is quiet and incredibly safe, and the rooms are large, which is rare in central Rome.
Casa Monti is about the neighborhood. There are authentic trattorias all around, and the hotel itself is hip, young and fun, for anyone who wants something other than the classic luxury hotels.
If you want space, quiet and a beautiful spa, pick the Corinthia. If you are a younger couple who wants personality and a real Roman neighborhood, pick Casa Monti.

guide.alt: Casa Monti’s downstairs restaurant, with striped banquettes, wicker chairs and a marble-fronted bar
paras: Casa Monti is on Via Panisperna in Monti, and the neighborhood is the real thing. When I visited on a Sunday, real Romans were having lunch at the trattorias around it. Inside, there is a lively restaurant downstairs and a beautiful one on the roof.
The Corinthia is on Piazza del Parlamento. It is quiet and walkable to everything, which is the draw.

guide.alt: A Corinthia Rome bathroom in onyx and marble, with a freestanding stone tub and a crystal chandelier
paras: Space is the story at the Corinthia: large, tastefully appointed rooms, onyx and marble bathrooms, and bedrooms that open onto terraces. It is new, so room categories and views vary. I’ll steer you to the right one.
At Casa Monti, the rooms are all personality: super cool patterns, details everywhere and curtains that hide the TV.

guide.alt: The Casa Monti spa lounge with wicker loungers in a lemon-print fabric, yellow walls and a mosaic floor
paras: At Casa Monti, couples can book the spa just for the two of them, which makes it great for couples. I arrange it before you arrive.
The Corinthia’s spa is beautiful, as are the public spaces, which are big enough that the hotel never feels crowded.

guide.alt: A Corinthia Rome suite with double-height windows, a gilded mirror over the sofa and a marble table
paras: The Corinthia’s renovation is a showstopper from the moment you walk in. I was blown away.
Casa Monti is from the same company as Le Fantaisie in Paris, and it shows: pattern on pattern, and a yellow vintage Fiat 500 parked out front.

faq.q: Which is better, the Corinthia or Casa Monti?
faq.a: They suit different travelers. The Corinthia for large rooms, a beautiful spa and a quiet, central base. Casa Monti for younger couples who want something hip, young and fun in a real Roman neighborhood.

faq.q: Which is better for a honeymoon?
faq.a: For younger honeymooners who want something fun, Casa Monti, with the spa booked just for the two of you. For space and quiet, the Corinthia.
The Corinthia’s spa is beautiful. Casa Monti’s can be booked privately, which makes it great for couples.
The Corinthia. Its rooms are large, which is rare in central Rome.
The Corinthia, across the street from parliament. Casa Monti has a lively restaurant downstairs and trattorias all around, which is the point.
